title: Patch: leaving a live co-op game asks first, and says your teammate plays on beside the AI
thread:
**Issue #2973 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2973: Patch: leaving a live co-op game asks first, and says your teammate plays on beside the AI
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
In an online 1v1 match, pressing Back mid-game asks whether you really want to leave. A co-op game does not ask: one stray back gesture on a phone takes you off the board, and a minute later the AI is playing your seat beside your teammate. Once built, the co-op table asks too, in words that fit: your teammate plays on, and after 60 seconds the AI plays your seat until you come back.

## Why
- R2479000, which added the 1v1 question, left this open on purpose: "The co-op table asks nothing yet: there a disconnect hands the seat to the AI rather than losing (§13.8), which needs other words." `apps/web/README.md` repeats it.
- `apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.tsx`: the Back link (line 219) and `onLeave` (lines 242-245) navigate at once, while `routes/match.tsx:329-344` holds the same moves with `guardLeaving`.
- §13.8: past `DISCONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS` the AI plays the seat and the teammate is told.

## Proposal
- `DuosRoute` uses `guardLeaving` while the shown view has no result and the socket is neither closed nor refused, as the 1v1 route does.
- `ConfirmLeaveMatch` takes its sentence as a prop. The co-op one names the teammate and the AI and reads the grace from the generated server config, never a literal (CLAUDE.md rule 9).
- Play again's forced move (`force: true`) stays unheld.
- A ruling in the issue's block amends R2479000, with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<issue>.md`; `apps/web/README.md`'s sentence is updated.

## Where it lands
`apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.tsx`, `apps/web/src/game/ConfirmLeaveMatch.tsx`, `apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.test.tsx`, `apps/web/README.md`, `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`, `spec/rulings/`, `spec/pending/`; SPEC §13.8.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A test named after the new ruling: with a live co-op view, Back shows the leave dialog; Stay keeps the board; Leave navigates.
- [ ] A finished co-op game, or a closed socket, asks nothing.
- [ ] Play again's forced move is not held.
- [ ] The dialog's number comes from the generated config.
- [ ] The 1v1 leave tests pass unchanged, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.

## Size and risks
Small to medium, mostly the ruling and the wording. A guard left armed after the game ends would hold Play again; the forced move covers that.

---
Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it.

Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it.

2. **Pending paragraph.** Write `spec/pending/2973.md` with one line in the `11-rulings.md` style: `**[[R2973000]] … (issue #2973, 2026-11-04)**: …` followed by the same two-sentence summary as the note.

Come back within {seconds} seconds or it counts as a loss.", { seconds: DISCONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS })}` in the existing `concede-dialog__body` paragraph. Update the file header comment's first line to note the dialog takes its sentence as a prop (R2973000). Do not touch `routes/match.tsx`: the default keeps it working with zero changes.
5. **Route guard.** In `apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.tsx`: extend the `../net/navigate.ts` import with `guardLeaving` and the `@jackioh/server-config` import with `DISCONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS`; add `import ConfirmLeaveMatch from "../game/ConfirmLeaveMatch.tsx";`. After the `yourMove` effect, copy the `routes/match.tsx:332-344` pattern verbatim (renaming nothing): `const [leaving, setLeaving] = useState<{ leave: () => void } | null>(null);`, `const atStake = view !== null && view.result === null && match.connection !== "closed" && match.connection !== "refused";`, and the `useEffect` on `[atStake]` that arms `guardLeaving((leave) => { setLeaving({ leave }); })` and releases plus `setLeaving(null)` on cleanup. In the final `app-shell` return, after `</DuosChromeContext.Provider>`, render `{leaving === null ? null : (<ConfirmLeaveMatch body={t("Your teammate plays on without you. After {seconds} seconds the AI plays your seat until you come back.", { seconds: DISCONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS })} onStay={() => { setLeaving(null); }} onLeave={leaving.leave} />)}`. Leave `chrome.back` (`BackLink to={paths.together}`), `onLeave`, and `goToMatch`'s `{ force: true }` exactly as they are: the guard holds the first two and skips the third by itself. Copy these two English strings exactly; the i18n scanner only sees `t()` literals.
6. **Chinese entry.** In `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`, add `"Your teammate plays on without you. After {seconds} seconds the AI plays your seat until you come back.": "你的队友会继续战斗。{seconds} 秒后，AI 将替你出战，直到你回来。"` beside the existing 1v1 entry. The `R711000 every sentence … has a zh-CN entry` test fails without it, and the token test requires the identical `{seconds}` token.

8. **Tests.** In `apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.test.tsx`, add the imports and the `describe("R2973000 leaving a live co-op game asks first, and names the teammate and the AI")` block from the Tests section below. Follow the file's existing `#1792` helpers (`open()`/`push()`) and the R2092000 block's `at("/duos/dm-1")` / `at("/")` handling; push `duosView(1)` for live and `duosView(3, { outcome: "win", winner: "b", reason: "concede" })` for finished, exactly as the R2092000 block builds `FINISHED`.
9. **Run the checks** listed in Tests, then `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Tests

New block in `apps/web/src/duos/DuosRoute.test.tsx` (imports to add: `DISCONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS` from `@jackioh/server-config`; `leaveMatchTestid` from `../game/ConfirmLeaveMatch.tsx`; `navigate, paths` from `../net/navigate.ts`; `navTestid` from `../routes/nav.tsx`):

- `it("R2973000 the co-op Back on a live game asks first and stays; Stay keeps the board, Leave goes to Play together")`: `at("/duos/dm-1")`, render, open socket, `push(duosView(1))`; click `nav-back`; assert pathname stays `/duos/dm-1`, dialog shows `Leave the match?` and `Your teammate plays on without you. After ${DISCONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS} seconds the AI plays your seat until you come back.`, and focus is on `leave-match-stay`; click Stay, dialog gone, pathname unchanged; click Back again, click Leave, pathname is `/together`.
- `it("R2973000 a finished co-op game asks nothing")`: push the finished view, click `nav-back`, no dialog, pathname `/together`.
- `it("R2973000 a closed co-op socket asks nothing")`: push `duosView(1)`, `act(() => { latest().onclose?.({ code: VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE, reason: "", wasClean: true }); })`, click `nav-back`, no dialog, pathname `/together`.
- `it("R2973000 Play again's forced move is not held")`: push `duosView(1)`, open the dialog via Back, then `act(() => { navigate(paths.duos("dm-2"), { force: true }); })`; pathname is `/duos/dm-2`, dialog gone. This is the exact mechanism `goToMatch` uses.

Commands: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/duos/DuosRoute.test.tsx`; `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/match.test.tsx` (must pass unchanged); `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/i18n/i18n.test.ts`; `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`; `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- [ ] Live co-op Back opens the dialog with the teammate/AI sentence and the generated grace number; Stay keeps the board, Leave navigates.
- [ ] Finished game and closed/refused socket navigate at once with no dialog.
- [ ] Forced move (`force: true`) is never held; Play again path untouched.
- [ ] New zh-CN entry present with matching `{seconds}` token.
- [ ] 1v1 leave tests pass unchanged; `spec check` passes; README no longer says the co-op board asks nothing.

## Risks

- Guard left armed after the game ends would hold Play again: the `[atStake]` effect cleanup releases it the moment a result lands, and the finished-game test pins it. Do not add timers or extra state.
- The dialog must carry no view data (rule 7): it holds only static words plus the public grace number.
- `t()` must be called with the literal at the call site; passing a key through the prop would hide it from the i18n scanner and fail the zh-CN coverage test.
- `DevDuosRoute.tsx` keeps its own `onLeave` and is out of scope (dev hotseat, no server grace).

## Open questions

None. Wording, prop shape (optional `body` defaulting to the 1v1 line), ruling number (R2973000, first free in the block), and the untouched 1v1 path are all settled above; the rejected alternatives were a required prop (would churn `match.tsx`) and editing `R2479000.md` beyond its stale sentence (numbers are never reused, prose stays).
```
